metadata.title: Warm Retro Portrait with Bold Lowercase Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A close-up, intimate portrait with a warm amber color cast and heavy, ultra-bold lowercase typography anchored at the bottom.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, slightly tilted close-up of a person with blonde curly hair lying down, characterized by a warm, golden-hour color palette and a grainy film texture. The composition is dominated by a massive, ultra-bold red lowercase wordmark that sits in the lower third of the frame, partially overlapping the subject's hair.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones harmonizing with golden-blonde hair
Deep red typography contrasting against amber backgrounds
Soft focus on hair vs. sharp focus on the eyes
Heavy typographic weight balancing the delicate facial features

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies the upper two-thirds of the frame, tilted diagonally from top-left to center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold red wordmark at the bottom acts as a heavy visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's gaze, follows the curve of the hair down to the large red text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with the subject and the large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber and golden browns (background and hair)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pinks and reds (lips and cheeks)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red text; low-to-medium value contrast in the photographic elements to maintain a soft, vintage feel.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'i' uses a square tittle (dot) that sits very close to the stem

composition.scale: large, spanning the width of the frame
composition.overlap: overlaps the bottom of the subject's hair

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font usage for maximum impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and vintage geometric feel
Provides the necessary lowercase impact and clean terminals

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a person with blonde curly hair lying down, shot with a warm amber filter and 35mm film grain. The lighting should be soft and golden, focusing on the eyes and lips.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single word in the bottom third of the image using an ultra-bold, lowercase sans-serif font in a deep red color. Ensure the letters are tightly spaced and span nearly the full width of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette warm and amber-toned?
Is the font weight extremely heavy?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the amber color cast
Specific shade of red for the text
Tightness of the crop on the face
mustRedesign: Any thin or elegant serif fonts
postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not obscure the eyes
Ensure the red text is the most saturated element
Verify the grain is consistent across the image
Confirm the lowercase 'i' has a square dot
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm-toned portrait + Ultra-bold lowercase sans-serif wordmark in red = Retro-modern editorial cover.
